summary: Cadeler plc filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated 11 November 2026 announcing an exclusivity agreement with an undisclosed client for wind turbine and foundation installation at a large-scale UK offshore wind farm, with the campaign expected to commence around 2030. No price, stake, or consideration is disclosed. Foundations would use an A-Class and O-Class vessel; turbines a P-Class vessel. No board recommendation, advisor, or transaction terms are stated. This is an ordinary commercial services agreement, not a special situation; watch for conversion to a binding contract.
